title: GradingBatchCreateRequest
description:
Create a read with its tasks in one request (POST /v1/grading/batches; admin). The body carries the tasks inline — for the R-dev read, the importer (grading-ui.md phase 2) builds it from the committed package (`rdev_sample.json` + the labels file); the API does not read files. Everything is validated before anything is stored: a batch is created whole or not at all.

`readers` take the share-grantee vocabulary MINUS the group forms: a value containing `:` is a full `issuer:subject` string kept verbatim; `@service:<subject>` names an API-key principal and keeps its subject colon-free (the form to use for a keyed reader — a bare name would be qualified to `bvbrc:<name>`, an identity the key never authenticates as, and the reader would 404 on their own batch); a bare BV-BRC username is prefixed to `bvbrc:<username>`. `@public` / `@group:<id>` are rejected (422): a read is assigned to people, and label order is a list of people. The resolved subjects are echoed back as `GradingBatch.readers` in the same order, so a typo is visible before a reader is told there is nothing to read.

rubric_sha256.description: sha256 of the frozen rubric (64 lowercase hex).

order_seed.description: Seed for the per-reader orders (see `GradingBatch`). Required, never defaulted: the study records its seeds before any pair is read.

readers.description: The readers in LABEL order (first = `A`). At least one; two for the SPEC §6.6.2 protocol. Duplicates after resolution are a 422.

tasks.description: The tasks in BATCH order — the draw's order, which is the order the export's CSV rows use. `pair_id` MUST be unique within the batch (422).
